name: list_alerts
description: List alerts from the proactive API system. ALWAYS use this tool for ANY alert-related query, including: 'any alerts?', 'what alerts do I have?', 'show alerts', 'check alerts', 'pending alerts?', 'any notifications?', 'what's broken?', etc. NEVER answer alert questions from memory or context - always call this tool to get current state. Shows alerts received via webhooks (Uptime Kuma, Coolify, Docker monitoring, cron jobs, etc.). For memory/knowledge base queries (past info), use search_memory or semantic_recall instead.

limit.description: Maximum number of alerts to return (default: 10)
